arithmetic: Interpret index_word as signed int32, without an out-of-range unsigned-to-signed conversion.
0x414C1983..0x414C1994 uses signed IMUL high product with 0x1B4E81B5, logical sign extraction, SAR 4 and sign correction: quotient = trunc_toward_zero(signed_index / 150).
0x1B4E81B5 = ceil(2^36 / 150); the high-product/SAR correction is the signed constant-division sequence, not unsigned division.
remainder = signed_index - quotient * 150, range [-149,149]. Negative values stay negative; no normalization to [0,149].
byte_offset = uint32(remainder) * 0x98 modulo 2^32; all returned addresses are raw32 additions, never host pointers or dereferenced original memory.
